title: EPRS/GluRS promotes gastric cancer development via WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Liu, Hui; Fredimoses, Mangaladoss; Niu, Peijia; Liu, Tingting; Qiao, Yan; Tian, Xueli; Chen, Xiaobing; Kim, Dong Joon; Li, Xiang; Liu, Kangdong; Dong, Zigang
journal: Gastric cancer : official journal of the International Gastric Cancer Association and the Japanese Gastric Cancer Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EPRS/GluRS通过WNT信号通路促进胃癌发展，虽涉及蛋白互作和计算机对接，但核心是肿瘤生物学而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Glutamyl-prolyl-tRNA synthetase (EPRS/GluRS) is primarily part of the multi-synthetase complex that may play a key role in cancer development. However, the biological function, molecular mechanism, and inhibitor of EPRS have not been investigated in gastric cancer (GC). METHODS: Immunohistochemistry was performed to detect the expression of EPRS in human gastric tumor tissues. Knocking down of EPRS, cell-derived xenograft mouse model, and patient-derived xenograft mouse model was used to identify the biological function of EPRS. Immunoprecipitation was applied to elucidate the interaction between EPRS and SCYL2. Computer docking model and multiple in vitro and in vivo experiments were conducted to discover EPRS inhibitors. RESULTS: Here, we report that EPRS is frequently overexpressed in GC tissues compared to that adjacent controls and its overexpression predicts poor prognosis in GC patients. Functionally, high expression of EPRS positively co-relates with GC development both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, EPRS directly binds with SCYL2 to enhance the activation of WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway and the accumulation of beta-catenin in the nuclear, leading to GC cell proliferation and tumor growth. Moreover, we identified that xanthoangelol (XA) and 4-hydroxyderricin (4-HD) can directly bind to EPRS to block WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway. More importantly, XA and 4-HD restrain gastric cancer patient-derived xenograft tumor growth and Helicobacter pylori combined with alcohol-induced atrophic gastritis and gastric tumorigenesis. CONCLUSION: These findings unveil a promising strategy for GC prevention and therapy by targeting EPRS-mediated WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin cascades. Moreover, XA and 4-HD may be effective reagents used for GC prevention and therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：谷氨酰-脯氨酰-tRNA合成酶（EPRS/GluRS）主要作为多合成酶复合体的一部分，可能在癌症发展中发挥关键作用。然而，在胃癌（GC）中，EPRS的生物学功能、分子机制及其抑制剂尚未被研究。方法：采用免疫组织化学方法检测人胃肿瘤组织中EPRS的表达。通过敲低EPRS、细胞源性异种移植小鼠模型和患者源性异种移植小鼠模型，鉴定EPRS的生物学功能。应用免疫沉淀法阐明EPRS与SCYL2之间的相互作用。通过计算机对接模型及多项体外和体内实验，发现EPRS抑制剂。结果：本文报道，与相邻对照组织相比，EPRS在GC组织中频繁过表达，且其过表达预示GC患者预后不良。功能上，EPRS的高表达在体外和体内均与GC发展正相关。机制上，EPRS直接与SCYL2结合，增强WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin信号通路的激活及beta-catenin在核内的积累，从而促进GC细胞增殖和肿瘤生长。此外，我们鉴定出xanthoangelol（XA）和4-hydroxyderricin（4-HD）能直接结合EPRS，阻断WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin信号通路。更重要的是，XA和4-HD能抑制胃癌患者源性异种移植肿瘤的生长，以及幽门螺杆菌联合酒精诱导的萎缩性胃炎和胃肿瘤发生。结论：这些发现揭示了通过靶向EPRS介导的WNT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin级联反应进行GC预防和治疗的一种有前景的策略。此外，XA和4-HD可能作为有效的试剂用于GC的预防和治疗。
